name: Cuckoo-spit Insect
desc: Cuckoo-spit Insect (Philaenus spumarius): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 14 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Philaenus spumarius, the meadow froghopper or meadow spittlebug, is a species of insect belonging to the spittlebug family Aphrophoridae.
